_comment: Model bindings for ./dev eval. Copy to evaluation/config.json (gitignored) to change one; --config <file> replaces both. Each binding starts cmd (repo-relative when it holds a /, else found on PATH) with args, where {{system_prompt_file}} and {{user_message_file}} become the paths of the prompt files. The wrapper gets model as EVAL_MODEL. extract_path is the dotted path to the answer in the JSON the wrapper prints, or null when stdout is the answer. retries is how many more attempts follow a failed first one. The fields are documented in evaluation/core/config.ts.

generator-agent.description: A Claude agent in a generator workspace writes a Blueprint V2 from a brief.

generator-api.description: One OpenRouter call writes a Blueprint V2 from a brief. Set model to an OpenRouter model id; the key is read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY, else .env.local in the config root.

blueprint-judge.description: A Claude agent in a judge workspace judges one blueprint dimension.

game-judge.description: One Claude call judges a played game against one gm_* judge.

turn-judge.description: One Claude call judges one replayed turn.

investigator.description: One Claude call chooses the self-play investigator's next typed line; the caller reads structured_output from the Claude CLI's JSON envelope.

narrator-claude.description: One Claude call narrates a replayed turn from the real narrator prompt.

narrator-openai.description: One OpenAI call narrates a replayed turn. Needs the openai CLI on PATH and OPENAI_API_KEY.

narrator-stub.description: No model: a fixed, content-free narration, for offline runs.

judge-stub.description: No model: a fixed passing verdict for any judge, for offline runs.
